text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the shopping district to run some errands, I bumped into Hishi Amazon
and an Umamusume from the Miho Dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a coincidence! Out shopping too, Trainer-boy?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"We just popped over to the craft store
around the corner for a bit."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm pretty confident in my dexterity!
I do plenty of cooking and needlework, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "My clothes rip and fray all the time when I'm running anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Just a moment ago, I borrowed a storefront to quickly fix up this child's clothes.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You really saved me, Sis Hishiama!
I didn't know what to do when my uniform tore...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about stuff like this!
More importantly, make sure your injury heals up properly!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much!
Well then, I'll head back first.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If you ever run into any trouble living on your own, Trainy,
just say the word!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was thinking about how caring she is,
it turns out Hishi Amazon had done some personal shopping too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, they had a bunch of new arrivals in stock!
I ended up buying all sorts of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I use it for patches on clothes or making small accessories—
well, ya know, it combines a hobby with practical use.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Trainy, you...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh no!
Isn't the hem of your jacket coming undone?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you're hopeless.
Good thing it was me who noticed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Here, let me have that for a sec!
I'll fix it up in a jiffy!
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll do it big and bold!
Got it, I'll make it nice and flashy!
Even if it takes time, I'll do it myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Here, let me have that for a sec!
I'll fix it up in a jiffy!
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll do it big and bold!
Got it, I'll make it nice and flashy!
Even if it takes time, I'll do it myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, roger that!
Let's head over to the park bench for now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, this'll be a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon took out a sewing kit
and quickly mended the frayed hem for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, all done!
Now, try it on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh, how do you like that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: While I was at it, I noticed a hole along with the frayed threads, so I went ahead and patched it up too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, I noticed a leopard-print patch
had been sewn over the hole in the jacket...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It makes for quite a nice accent, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, something like this is no big deal!
You really don't have to worry about it at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since they went through the trouble of giving it to me,
I decided I would treasure it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well, you're an adult too, Trainy!
If you say you're fine with this, then I won't worry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, you look pretty sloppy like that.
Wouldn't it be better to fix it real quick?”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I always carry my sewing kit with me.
I'll lend you mine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I borrowed a sewing kit from Hishi Amazon,
and as I was fixing a loose thread on my jacket on a bench...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah, did you prick yourself with the needle?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! You gotta treat that right away!
Hold on, I always carry band-aids with me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There, that should do it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely at the bandage on my fingertip,
I realize it has a cute cat pattern on it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looking at this bandage will keep you from
doing anything reckless, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty popular with the younger girls too.
Well, it's just like making character bento!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainy, you'd better make sure you
don't go hurting yourself from now on, too!"
